meta.method: Per-metric provenance for the comparison table. Values not carried here fall back to av-companies.json and are shown as 'carried from the site dataset'. Every URL appeared in an actual search result, primary source preferred. A metric that could not be verified is recorded as a typed null with a reason rather than omitted.

confidence.disclosed: Stated by the company or in a filing.
confidence.reported: Carried by a major outlet, not company-confirmed in this pass.
confidence.estimated: Derived or modelled on this site, not observed.
confidence.not-disclosed: The company has never published this figure.
confidence.parent-funded: Wholly owned; the figure does not exist separately.
confidence.unverified: Circulating figures exist but none could be tied to a source in this pass.

knownGaps: Live market capitalisation is read from the quote endpoint at page load where a ticker exists. When that endpoint is not configured the cell reads 'listed, quote unavailable' rather than showing a stale number.
Private valuations are point-in-time marks from the last round that disclosed one. They are not comparable to a market capitalisation and are labelled distinctly in the table.

Fleet, real-mile and virtual-mile figures are carried from av-companies.json, where they were compiled from company statements and permit filings of varying vintage. They are not audited and rarely share an as-of date across companies.
